title: Startup word is polynomial-time computable
statement: The function that maps each bit string $x$ to the encoded startup state for $x$ is computable by a finite Turing machine in time $C(|x|+1)^c$ for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
replaced:
The function sending a binary string to the encoded seam word of its startup
state — including the right-boundary offset on invalid inputs — is
polynomial-time computable, before any clause emission.
